results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage by Il Resto del Carlino detailing an empirical study led by Fabio Giglietto on Meta's algorithms and political content policies, highlighting how visibility reductions disproportionately affected parliamentary representatives while boosting fringe accounts.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: University news coverage summarizing media attention (including a report by Rai3's 'Report') and political inquiries in the European Parliament stemming from research on Meta's algorithms led by Professor Fabio Giglietto.
